description: This file defines the GatewayInternalErrorException class, a specific runtime exception used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate internal errors in the API Gateway. It includes static factory methods, a builder class, and metadata annotations related to exception handling.

classes.name: GatewayInternalErrorException
classes.description: A final class representing an internal error exception in the API Gateway, extending DittoRuntimeException and implementing GatewayException.

classes.name: GatewayInternalErrorException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing instances of GatewayInternalErrorException with a fluent API, marked as thread-unsafe.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new mutable builder for creating GatewayInternalErrorException instances.

methods.name: fromMessage
methods.description: Creates a GatewayInternalErrorException from a message string and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a GatewayInternalErrorException from a JSON object and headers.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with the specified headers.
